bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active
python3 - <<'PY'
import json,subprocess,sys
from pathlib import Path
for chat,topic,group,expected in [
 (-1002373696859,1613,'video',{4623,4609,4595}),
 (-1003770334893,210,'category',{1133,1115,1097}),
 (-1003847210571,48,'area',None)
]:
 p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'scripts/userbot_topic_audit_client.py','--chat-id',str(chat),'--page','0'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=110)
 if p.returncode:raise SystemExit(61)
 results=[json.loads(x.split('=',1)[1]) for x in p.stdout.splitlines() if x.startswith("USERBOT_TOPIC_AUDIT=")]
 if len(results)!=1:raise SystemExit(62)
 item=next((x for x in results[0]['rows'] if x['topic_id']==topic),None)
 ledger=Path('deploy/state/profile-topic-only-20261122')/(str(topic)+'.json')
 if not ledger.is_file() or not item:raise SystemExit(63)
 record=json.loads(ledger.read_text())
 if record.get('state')!='PUBLISHED' or item.get('post_button')!='PRESENT' or 'profile' not in item.get('button_types',[]):raise SystemExit(64)
 mids=set(record['message_ids'])
 if expected is not None and mids!=expected:raise SystemExit(65)
 if not mids.issubset(set(item.get('history_message_ids',[]))):raise SystemExit(66)
 print(f"PROFILE_BUTTON_LIVE_VERIFIED_TOPIC={topic} MESSAGES={','.join(map(str,sorted(mids)))}")
print("PROFILE_THREE_TOPICS_USERBOT_READBACK=PASS")
PY
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active
